fda.text: ABUSE, MISUSE, AND ADDICTION AZSTARYS has a high potential for abuse and misuse, which can lead to the development of a substance use disorder, including addiction. summary: This medicine carries the strongest type of warning from the FDA because it has a high risk of abuse, misuse, and addiction, which can lead to overdose and death [4]. The official label also warns to avoid giving this medicine to people with serious heart disease, and it advises checking for increases in blood pressure and heart rate [4]. Additionally, a similar drug called methylphenidate has a top-level warning for misuse and damage to the nervous system [3]. In tests from a small computer model rather than studies in people, the drug received a medium risk score of 53 for the liver and a low risk score of 38 for the heart [M].
